name: animos
summary: Ready-made motion templates that turn images or videos into design showcase videos, exported as MP4 or WebM in the browser.
description: A browser-based tool for showcasing designs in motion. Pick a ready-made animation template, drop in your images or videos, tweak the settings, and export MP4 or WebM — no installs. The site renders client-side only, so the template catalogue and pricing are not readable without JavaScript.
contains: browser app with ready-made animation templates
